readings.meaning: developer mode or dev tools badge

ambiguity: At small sizes the three letters blur into an unreadable dark band inside a square, and outside software circles 'DEV' is just an arbitrary three-letter abbreviation.

reasoning: The icon consists solely of the letters 'DEV' inside a rounded square outline (the DEV Community logo / developer badge). Because it is purely typographic letters rather than a pictorial object, it violates the rule against text-only badges and is hard to read at small list sizes, whereas coding tasks are better served by a code brackets or terminal icon.
